segments.name: Direct-to-Consumer
segments.description: Sells Byrna launchers, projectiles, sprays and accessories directly to consumers online, through Amazon and in Company-operated retail stores.
segments.evidence: Direct‑to‑Consumer ("DTC") – includes sales through the Company's e‑commerce websites, Amazon storefronts, and Company‑operated retail stores

segments.name: Wholesale
segments.description: Supplies Byrna launchers, projectiles and defensive sprays to distributors, law-enforcement agencies, retailers and international distributors for resale or duty use.
segments.evidence: Wholesale ("dealer/distributor") – includes sales to distributors, law‑enforcement agencies, retailers, and international distributors

revenueModel.text: Consumers and security professionals pay the company for less-lethal launchers, projectiles, sprays and accessories, bought directly online or in stores or through dealers, distributors and retailers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold in both the consumer and security professional markets.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company sold its ownership interest in its Latin American joint venture, Byrna LATAM, to an affiliate of Bersa S.A.
changes.evidence: On August 19, 2024, we sold our 51% ownership interest to Fusady S.A., an affiliate of Bersa S.A.

changes.text: Beginning in fiscal 2025 the Company reports through two sales channels, Direct-to-Consumer and Wholesale.
changes.evidence: Beginning in fiscal 2025, the Company manages its operations through two reportable channels: ( 1 ) Direct‑to‑Consumer ("DTC") – includes sales through the Company's e‑commerce websites, Amazon storefronts, and Company‑operated retail stores, and ( 2 ) Wholesale ("dealer/distributor") – includes sales to distributors, law‑enforcement agencies, retailers, and international distributors.
